note: Stage 1 (Payments agent, LLM-written specialist answers, degraded flag, one critic re-plan). Warm round only. Measured with REQUEST_LLM_BUDGET_SECONDS=300 (compose default is 90) to observe the full model path; OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=90 per call. OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=2. route_ok and route-correct latency were added afterwards from the recorded traces (same code as scripts/benchmark_latency.py); no request was re-run.
method: Wall-clock latency of POST /api/chat, fresh session per latency request, user_id cliente1988. cold = all Ollama models unloaded before each request; warm = models resident. Latency mean/p95 use llm_complete responses only; fallbacks and errors are not successes.
outcome_definition:
llm_complete | fallback_budget | fallback_error | http_error.

    Only llm_complete counts as success: every model step the route needs ran
    and returned a valid result. Deterministic policy outcomes (clarification,
    handoff, safety) after a successful contextual model call are complete.
